name: 引用と階層リストを含む共有投稿
prompt:
Create a clean, flat Lighthouse-style Japanese shared-post component on a white 390×632 px canvas. Use the native preview for the exact Japanese copy, component boundaries, hierarchy and spacing. Use the original screenshot crop for the source list, quote, code block, and emoji details. The screenshot crop starts partway through a line at its top edge; do not add that clipped fragment because the native preview gives the complete Japanese body copy.

Preserve the full component content exactly as shown in the preview:
Author: 山田 はるか
Body:
次の打ち合わせに向けて
準備したい内容です。
Nested list:
1. 参考になる事例
   あ. 動画の資料
   い. その他の資料
2. 下書きを作る
3. 資料をまとめる
Quote:
それぞれの話し合いでメモを残してください。
この進め方をみんなで考えていきましょう。
Code heading: 強調したコードの例
Code: <メモ>一緒に進めましょう。</メモ>
Footer names: 山田さん　佐藤さん
Attribution: 交流のアイデアに投稿・1日前

The only hyperlink in this correction is 動画の資料. Render that text in clear link blue #1976D2 with no underline. It corresponds to the blue YouTube hyperlink in the original screenshot; this corrects the native preview's green link text. Do not recolor the green code heading, member names, gray attribution, quote, numbered list labels, or literal code.

Preserve the native preview's compact white card, fine neutral outline, Japanese Meiryo hierarchy, pale mint code block, dark code text, quiet quote divider, green initials avatar and green emphasis. The original screenshot also has a small raised-hands emoji before the member names; retain it at the footer in its original full-color appearance, then show the exact Japanese names from the preview. Do not add @ symbols, buttons, toolbar, new content, or decorative color. Keep all copy Japanese and all other visible styles as in the preview.

Use the close-up original hyperlink crop only to match the blue text treatment. Use the approved community image only as a restrained Japanese UI style cue; do not copy its icon tiles, blue circles, or layout.

Second and final correction: use the native component preview as the exact scale and position authority. In v001, Japanese glyphs look about 15–20% too large and the vertical gaps are expanded. Reduce the apparent text size by about 15–20%, tighten line height and section gaps to the native preview, and align the start of the body, nested list, quote, code block and footer with the preview. Keep the complete 390×632 card, all copy and hierarchy exact, with no wrapping or clipping. Preserve 動画の資料 in blue #1976D2, the green member names and code heading, gray attribution, full-color raised-hands emoji, mint code panel and quiet quote divider. Do not change any wording, color role or component boundary.
reviewNotes: v002 final attempt compared against native preview at 390x632. The semantic link 動画の資料 is blue #1976D2; green member names/code heading, gray attribution, source emoji, exact copy and content hierarchy are retained. The explicit scale and spacing correction did not materially reduce the oversized text or expanded vertical gaps, so keep needs-correction after the two-attempt limit. Full raw ImageGen frame used without cropping; raw path and SHA-256 are recorded in review-w02-a002.json.
reviewNotice: 画像生成候補。ネイティブ編集・実装・所有者承認とは別です。
